title: A drier, wetter or warmer year
intro: The weather file gives precipitation and air temperature to every model of the column. Scaling the rain and adding a warming to the same record shows how much the yield and the water use move with the weather, with the soil and the management unchanged.

marks.d: Adds a further factor, grouped by Irrigation, Nitrogen and tillage, Weather and climate, Soil and crop, and Chemicals.
